text:
ryan: paging: P1 - spike in 5xx in eu-west after regional cutover, seeing ~12% 5xx on host inference paths (baseline ~0.5%). noticed shortly after traffic shift at 00:02 UTC. canary/promote looked OK initially but errors climbed quickly.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 created · Sev: P1 · PagerDuty notified · runbook: regional-cutover-fallback
carla: oncall here, ack. quick question — is this a config mismatch or backend version drift? any customer-facing errors reported? :eyes: 
ryan: early signs point to routing -> some requests hitting older edge/backends that don't accept new header format. logs: ```error: Rejecting request - unknown model hash header
src=edge-12 eu-west
req_id=abcd1234 status=502 x-model-hash=unknown```
jordan: I see the same in traces. DNS weights flipped but TTLs means a subset of edge nodes still resolving to legacy pool. new backend expects header `x-model-hash` and returns 502 when absent/mismatched. only affects requests routed to those legacy nodes — roughly 8% of total EU traffic (spike coincides with TTL expiry window).
maggie: recommend immediate kill-switch on the region-level feature flag that enabled v2 routing: `geo_v2_enable_eu = true -> false`. That should stop any new directs to the new path and restore prior routing. also we should rollback canary if kill switch is insufficient.
ryan: applying kill switch now via console...
deploy-bot: feature-flag toggle applied: geo_v2_enable_eu=false by ryan at 00:18:23 UTC · change-id: ff-8342
ryan: seeing 5xx drop to ~1.1% already. continuing to monitor.
carla: good. start rollback to v1.3.1 canary snapshot for region to be safe. jordan, can you coordinate the rollback with infra?
jordan: rollback started at 00:22 UTC, downgrading routing policy to pre-cutover weights. command: ```infractl rollout set-weights --region eu-west --weights pre-cutover.json```
leah: product -> any impacted customers we should proactively notify?
ryan: initial list from logs: acme-corp (eu pin), beta-inc (eu pin), gamma-saas (eu regional routing). ops: opening tickets with affected accounts and SOC. estimated customer impact window ~00:02-00:20 UTC, peak errors around 00:10 UTC.
carla: metrics: error rate back to 0.4% now, latency normalized. will keep watch for TTL churn for next 2hrs. postmortem required to cover why routing and header expectations diverged and why canary didn't catch this.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 status: mitigated -> monitoring. runbook step completed: kill-switch + rollback. severity remains P1 until stable for 1h.
maggie: creating quick checklist for postmortem: 1) reproduce in staging with mixed TTLs, 2) add canary test for header compatibility, 3) ensure rollout gating includes edge cache invalidation plan.
carla: handing off to night oncall @jordan-night at 01:00 UTC. monitoring dashboard pinned, alert threshold lowered to 1% for next 2h. leaving notes in incident doc.
jordan: oncall ack, will escalate if 5xx >1% for 3 consecutive mins.
ryan: thanks all — summary posted to #incidents and customer ops. follow-up postmortem assigned to eng-runtime + infra. :white_check_mark:
